docs.creator: Mark Hijink
docs.description: In  Focus   – The ASML way , journalist Marc Hijink brings us a unique insider portrait of this global giant. Hijink not only details the company’s meteoric rise from a quiet town in the Netherlands to a powerful, global monopoly position, he also makes accessible the unbelievably complex technology that has been the key to ASML’s success. Its lithography machines, which spit out millions of chips around the clock, work to an accuracy of within a few atoms.
docs.title: Focus: The ASML Way
